Scheme one maintains the 3-yuan base fare but reduces initial and short-distance increments, minimally affecting short trips while significantly raising costs for longer distances. title: 美债到5%，吓坏了AI投资者
content: US long-term Treasury yields surged to 5%, with the 30-year yield hitting a 20-year high and the 10-year yield approaching 2007 levels. This spike—driven by massive government debt issuance (projected at $37.6 trillion by 2025), declining foreign and Fed demand, AI-related corporate bond issuance exceeding $1.2 trillion, and persistent inflation—has triggered broad asset repricing. Rising yields increase valuation pressure on AI stocks, particularly hardware companies and crowded trades like memory chips. The situation parallels the 2007 subprime crisis: high capital expenditures now face slowing revenue growth at firms like Anthropic, with investors already discounting AI valuations. Elevated rates also tighten overall financing conditions for the sector.

Industry insiders view the shakeout as necessary maturation, with surviving creators investing in original scripts, refined production, and licensed IPs.

title: 越来越多的聪明人开始悄悄“退网”
content: Some intelligent individuals are quietly withdrawing from online culture to reclaim their attention. The internet creates an illusion that consuming constant information equals wisdom, while actually eroding deep thinking. Social media platforms are designed like behavioral casinos, exploiting human instincts to capture and monetize attention. This digital environment transforms private experiences into performative content and replaces genuine connection with exposure metrics. Those who disconnect often find improved focus, healthier relationships, and restored capacity for sustained thought, discovering that much online content is trivial rather than essential.
